name: botscope
description: Look inside your own trading bots from your own Claude: honest backtests, a live 'what the bot sees' chart, a market desk, and safety rails. Paper trading by default. Not financial advice.

ALPACA_API_KEY.title: Alpaca PAPER Key ID (optional)
ALPACA_API_KEY.description: From your free Alpaca paper account (starts with PK). Leave empty to use made-up demo prices, or add it later in Studio's Get started tab. Paper keys only.

ALPACA_SECRET_KEY.title: Alpaca PAPER Secret Key (optional)
ALPACA_SECRET_KEY.description: The secret that goes with the Key ID above. Stored in your computer's secure credential store, never in a file.

FINNHUB_API_KEY.title: Finnhub API key (optional)
FINNHUB_API_KEY.description: Free at finnhub.io: earnings dates and analyst ratings on the Desk.

FRED_API_KEY.title: FRED API key (optional)
FRED_API_KEY.description: Free at fred.stlouisfed.org: economy panels and the economic calendar on the Desk.

SEC_USER_AGENT.title: SEC contact (optional)
SEC_USER_AGENT.description: Your name and email, e.g. 'Jane Doe jane@example.com'. The SEC asks for this on insider-filing requests.
